description: This PHP class 'DetailedLeaveRequest' manages leave request details including fetching related leaves, calculating number of days, leave breakdown, leave periods, balances, allowed actions, and workflows. It serves as a core component in handling leave request logic within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: DetailedLeaveRequest
classes.description: A class responsible for handling leave request related calculations, including fetching leaves, computing leave days, breakdowns, periods, balances, and permissible actions within the leave management system.

methods.name: getLeaveRequest
methods.description: Returns the LeaveRequest object associated with this detailed leave request.

methods.name: setLeaveRequest
methods.description: Sets the LeaveRequest object for this detailed leave request and resets internal cached properties.

methods.name: fetchLeaves
methods.description: Fetches all leaves related to the current leave request.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Returns the list of leaves, sorted by date.

methods.name: setLeaves
methods.description: Sets multiple leaves and updates internal date and leave arrays.

methods.name: addLeave
methods.description: Adds a single leave to the internal leave list and resets cache.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of leaves.

methods.name: getNoOfDays
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total number of leave days.

methods.name: getDatesDetail
methods.description: Returns detailed date information for the leave request.

methods.name: getLeaveBreakdown
methods.description: Returns breakdown of leaves by status, excluding weekends and holidays.

methods.name: getLeaveBalances
methods.description: Fetches leave balances per leave period for the employee and leave type.

methods.name: getLeavePeriods
methods.description: Calculates and returns leave periods based on leaves and strategy.

methods.name: hasMultipleStatus
methods.description: Indicates if the leave request has multiple statuses.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Returns allowed actions for the leave request, e.g., APPROVE, REJECT.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflows
methods.description: Retrieves permitted workflow transitions based on current leave status.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific action is permissible.

methods.name: getWorkflowForAction
methods.description: Fetches the workflow transition associated with a specific action.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the leave request, throws if multiple statuses exist.
